card.name: Spanish translation of spray instructions
card.fires_on: Words inside a Spanish-language passage of oral spray directions (Via de administracion oral, Agite 10 veces antes de usarlo, bajo la lengua). It responds on many tokens of that one Spanish text, not on one word.

modes.description: Partway through or just after Spanish words in the administration route line.
